В противном случае, в зависимости от выбранной далее настройки, записи будут автоматически отфильтрованы или запрос на загрузку завершится ошибкой.

broadcast.title: Broadcast notification
broadcast.description: Send an in-app notification to every user active in the last 30 days, or only to the user IDs and emails you list. With a link, clicking it opens the link in a new tab, and re-sending the same link skips users who already got it.

fields.title: Title
fields.titlePlaceholder: e.g. iOS app is in public beta 📱
fields.messagePlaceholder: Optional text shown under the title
fields.recipientsPlaceholder: Optional user IDs or emails, comma-separated, e.g. 12, jane@example.com. Empty = all active users
fields.recipientsError: Use positive whole-number IDs or valid emails, separated by commas

confirm.title: Send to all active users?
confirm.description: This creates a notification for every user active in the last 30 days. It can't be undone.
confirm.descriptionSelected: Unknown IDs and emails are skipped. It can't be undone.
